HassRememberFact: Required when the latest request explicitly asks to remember one stable, non-sensitive fact for future conversations. Never store instructions, commands, secrets, or temporary state.
HassForgetFact: Required when the latest request explicitly asks to forget one stored fact. Use its exact memory_id from Relevant Long-Term Memories.
HassSemanticSearch: Search missing device or tool matches. Describe the required action or capability, target, and known identifying context in query. Choose the narrowest scope.
HassPlannedAction: Use only when the latest request explicitly asks to schedule or delay an action by 1 to 1440 minutes. Never use for now, immediately, or an untimed request. Put the complete future action in description; this schedules rather than executes it.
HassListPlannedActions: List all pending one-time actions scheduled by this agent. This does not change them.
HassCancelAllPlannedActions: Cancel every pending one-time action scheduled by this agent. Use only when the user explicitly asks to cancel all of them.
